name: launcher
description: A game launcher mock-up: a carousel of the examples' screenshots, browsed with the mouse, keys or a gamepad.

scripts.build: bun gen-games.ts && bun build src/main.tsx --outdir dist --entry-naming game.[ext] --format iife --target browser --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"'
scripts.build:dev: bun gen-games.ts && bun build src/main.tsx --outdir dist --entry-naming game.[ext] --format iife --target browser --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"development"'
